title: jacobaea ambigua subsp. nebrodensis
intro: Jacobaea ambigua subsp. nebrodensis, commonly known as the Sardinian Ragwort, is a plant species within the daisy family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to promote the expulsion of mucus from the respiratory tract and has anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Jacobaea ambigua subsp. nebrodensis include its use as a diuretic and expectorant, and its potential to reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential benefits to human health.
